summary: XPeng Inc. filed a 6-K disclosing a subsidiary-level financing via a newly formed entity, Dogotix. XPeng Dogotix, along with investors (led by IDG Capital, with Gaorong, Tencent, Alibaba) and executive subscribers, agreed to subscribe for newly issued Dogotix Series A Preferred Shares and warrants. Aggregate investment totals US$1 billion (US$200M from XPeng, US$600M from investors, US$100M from executives, plus US$500M warrant exercise). The transaction includes redemption rights and adoption of the Dogotix 2026 Equity Incentive Plan. This appears to be a capital raise at the subsidiary level, not a special-situation event; classified under Capital Returns as a funding round involving equity issuance and potential future returns.
